gaps.note: The shared WebSearch budget (200 calls across all parallel agents) ran out after 17 searches in this segment. France, Spain, Italy, Netherlands, Belgium, Portugal, Nordics, Ireland, Poland and most Austria/Switzerland carriers were therefore NOT searched. These are gaps in coverage, not confirmed absence of public wordings. WebFetch is egress-blocked, so no URL was opened to check it.
Searched axa.de. Found only product and underwriting-requirement pages. The AVB appear to be only on the broker portal (entry.axa.de).
Searched. No cyber AVB PDF surfaced, only product pages and unrelated AVB.
An ERGO Austria snippet says the general conditions are available on request by email. No public PDF found.
No PDF clearly identified as the CYBERPROTECT AVB with an edition. Candidates are recorded but unconfirmed.
